description: Run one chat completion on any of VIA's 85 models (e.g. qwen3.7-flash, deepseek-chat, openai/gpt-5.4, anthropic/claude-sonnet-5.5; list and per-token prices at GET https://via-router.floot.app/_api/v1/models). Paid from prepaid VIA credit sent as the x-credit-token connection header (minimum 0.0027 USD per request); an empty answer is not charged. No key yet: POST /_api/credits_key, then top up at /credits (card) or POST /_api/credits_buy (x402 USDC).

max_tokens.description: Billed basis for output (use >= 512 for reasoning models)

model.description: Model id or alias from GET /_api/v1/models

requestId.description: Optional UUID; reuse only to retry the identical request without a second charge

name: via_ai_chat
title: VIA AI chat completion
